description: Deep audit across UI/UX, Performance, Functionality, and Security — 50 user stories covering error handling, accessibility, security hardening, performance optimization, missing features, and website/backend gaps

ralphLoop.verdict: Deep audit identified 50 new user stories across Security (critical), Performance, UI/UX, Functionality, and Website/Backend. Zero passing — work begins.

previousLoops.verdict: All 24 user stories implemented. Ship it.

userStories.title: Add authentication to extract-commitments Edge Function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the extract-commitments endpoint to require authentication so unauthenticated users can't drain AI credits.
acceptanceCriteria: extract-commitments/index.ts validates Authorization bearer token before processing
Returns 401 with error message if token missing or invalid
Token is verified against Supabase auth (same pattern as api-commitments)
Existing iOS client sends auth token in request header
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Currently a public endpoint with no auth. Anyone can call it and incur Anthropic API costs.

userStories.title: Add authentication to generate-dispute-summary Edge Function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the generate-dispute-summary endpoint to require authentication so only authenticated users can generate summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: generate-dispute-summary/index.ts validates Authorization bearer token before processing
Returns 401 with error message if token missing or invalid
CORS origin changed from wildcard '*' to specific domain whitelist
DisputeSummaryService.swift sends auth token in request header
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Currently public endpoint with CORS set to '*'. Anyone can call from any origin.

userStories.title: Implement JWS signature verification in subscription-webhook
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the subscription webhook to cryptographically verify Apple's JWS signatures so tampered payloads are rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: subscription-webhook/index.ts verifies JWS signature against Apple's public key certificate chain
Rejects payloads with invalid signatures (returns 400)
Logs verification failures for monitoring
Comment acknowledging incomplete verification is removed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Current implementation decodes but does not verify JWS signatures. A malicious actor could craft fake subscription events.

userStories.title: Add rate limiting to AI Edge Functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need rate limiting on expensive AI endpoints to prevent abuse and cost overruns.
acceptanceCriteria: extract-commitments limits to 10 requests per minute per authenticated user
generate-dispute-summary limits to 5 requests per minute per authenticated user
Rate limit state stored in Deno KV or Supabase
Returns 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header when exceeded
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No rate limiting on any Edge Function. AI endpoints are expensive — a single abusive user could generate large bills.

userStories.title: Implement token refresh and expiration handling in AuthService
userStories.description: As a Pro+ user, I need my authentication to refresh automatically so I don't get silently logged out when my token expires.
acceptanceCriteria: AuthService stores refresh token in Keychain alongside access token
AuthService checks token expiration before API calls
When access token is expired, automatically refreshes using refresh token
On 401 response from any API call, triggers token refresh and retries once
If refresh fails, sets isSignedIn to false and shows re-auth prompt
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current AuthService stores access token but never checks expiration or refreshes. All API calls will fail silently after token expires.

userStories.title: Add input validation and length limits on AI extraction
userStories.description: As a developer, I need input validation before sending text to AI to prevent abuse and control costs.
acceptanceCriteria: AIExtractionService validates text length (max 10,000 characters) before sending
AIExtractionService validates UTF-8 encoding
ScreenshotProcessingService checks text length before calling extractWithAI()
extract-commitments Edge Function validates text field length and type
Returns descriptive error message when validation fails
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: OCR text sent directly to AI with no length or encoding validation. A 100KB OCR text from a dense screenshot could be expensive.

userStories.title: Add certificate pinning for network calls
userStories.description: As a security-conscious user, I need the app to pin SSL certificates for API calls to prevent MITM attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a shared URLSession configuration with certificate pinning for supabase.co domain
AIExtractionService, SyncService, APIAccessService, DisputeSummaryService all use the pinned session
Pinning uses public key pinning (not certificate pinning) for rotation resilience
Include backup pin for key rotation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All network calls use URLSession.shared with no certificate pinning. MITM attacks could intercept AI requests and auth tokens.

userStories.title: Add confirmation dialogs for swipe dismiss/fulfill actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want a confirmation before swipe actions permanently change commitment status so I don't accidentally dismiss important items.
acceptanceCriteria: LedgerView swipe-to-dismiss shows confirmation alert with commitment summary before executing
LedgerView swipe-to-fulfill shows confirmation alert before executing
IPadLedgerView has the same confirmation dialogs
User can cancel the swipe action from the alert
Confirmation includes undo hint text
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Swipe actions immediately change status with no confirmation. Users report accidentally dismissing commitments.

userStories.title: Add pull-to-refresh to LedgerView
userStories.description: As a user, I want to pull-to-refresh my commitment list to trigger a manual scan for new screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: LedgerView List has .refreshable() modifier
Pull-to-refresh calls processOnForeground() logic (check screenshots, update statuses)
For Pro+ users, also triggers SyncService.pullCommitments()
Shows haptic feedback when refresh completes
IPadLedgerView also has pull-to-refresh
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Currently no way to manually trigger refresh — only happens automatically on app foreground.

userStories.title: Add error states and retry buttons throughout the app
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see clear error messages with retry options when operations fail, instead of silent failures.
acceptanceCriteria: ClipboardCommitmentView shows error alert if saveCommitment() fails (not silent try?)
CommitmentDetailView shows error alert if deleteCommitment() fails
EntityProfileView shows retry button if dispute summary generation fails
PrivacyAuditView shows error if export fails (not silent try?)
ManualEntryView shows error feedback if commitment save fails
All error messages are user-friendly (not raw error descriptions)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Multiple views use try? to swallow errors silently. Users get no feedback when operations fail.

userStories.title: Add loading states for async operations
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see loading indicators when the app is processing so I know it's working.
acceptanceCriteria: CommitmentDetailView shows ProgressView while screenshot loads asynchronously
ManualEntryView shows loading spinner on Save button during save
PrivacyInfoView shows ProgressView while loadPhotoInfo() runs
EntityProfileView shows ProgressView during initial data load
All loading states have a timeout (15s) after which an error state is shown
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Several async operations have no loading indicators, making the app feel unresponsive.

userStories.title: Add comprehensive accessibility labels and hints
userStories.description: As a VoiceOver user, I need all interactive elements and status indicators to have descriptive labels so I can use the app effectively.
acceptanceCriteria: CommitmentCardView status icon has accessibilityLabel describing current status (e.g., 'Status: Overdue')
ConfidenceBadgeView has accessibilityLabel explaining score meaning (e.g., 'Confidence: High, 9 out of 10')
DeadlineIndicatorView has accessibilityLabel with urgency text (not just color)
FilterView status circles have accessibilityLabel for each status name
EntityProfileView timeline nodes have text labels (not just colors)
All color-only indicators have text alternatives
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Multiple views rely on color alone to convey status/urgency. Color-blind and VoiceOver users cannot distinguish states.

userStories.title: Add Dynamic Type scaling for fixed-size elements
userStories.description: As a user with low vision, I need all UI elements to scale with Dynamic Type so text and controls are readable at my preferred size.
acceptanceCriteria: ConfidenceBadgeView frame uses @ScaledMetric instead of fixed 24x24
DeadlineIndicatorView uses @ScaledMetric for sizing
AICoachView progress bar scales with Dynamic Type
All fixed-width/height frames on text elements use @ScaledMetric
App tested at accessibility XXL text size without layout breaks
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Several views use fixed frame sizes that don't scale with Dynamic Type, making them unreadable at large text sizes.

userStories.title: Add filter amount validation and form feedback
userStories.description: As a user, I need form validation to prevent invalid filter/input configurations.
acceptanceCriteria: FilterView validates min amount <= max amount and shows inline error if invalid
ManualEntryView validates dollarAmount is positive number format
ManualEntryView shows inline error messages under invalid fields (not just disabled button)
Entity name input has max length (100 characters) with character counter
Summary text input has max length (500 characters) with character counter
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FilterView allows min > max amounts. ManualEntryView disables save button with no explanation of what's wrong.

userStories.title: Implement WatchConnectivity for bidirectional sync
userStories.description: As a Watch user, I need changes on my Watch to sync to my iPhone and vice versa so I always see current data.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyApp activates WCSession on launch
SeddlyWatchApp activates WCSession on launch
When a commitment is created/updated/deleted on iPhone, sends update to Watch via transferUserInfo()
When a commitment is fulfilled on Watch, sends update to iPhone
Handles reachability changes gracefully (queues updates when Watch is not reachable)
WatchLedgerView shows sync status indicator
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL GAP: Watch and iPhone maintain completely separate databases. Changes on one device never appear on the other.

userStories.title: Add SwiftData migration strategy
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a data migration strategy so schema changes in future updates don't lose user data.
acceptanceCriteria: SharedModelContainer.create() includes a MigrationPlan
MigrationPlan defines schema versions (V1 = current schema)
MigrationPlan includes a migration stage from V1 to V2 (even if empty, as template)
App handles migration failures gracefully with user notification
Unit test verifies migration plan is well-formed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No migration plan defined. Any model changes in a future update will crash the app for existing users.

userStories.title: Add widget deep link support
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tap a commitment in my widget to open that specific commitment in the app.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyWidget uses .widgetURL() modifier with seddly://commitment/{id} URL
SeddlyApp handles seddly:// URL scheme in onOpenURL
Tapping a commitment in widget navigates to CommitmentDetailView
If multiple commitments shown, each has correct deep link
project.yml registers seddly:// URL scheme
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Widget shows commitments but tapping only opens the app root. No deep linking to specific items.

userStories.title: Add pagination for large commitment lists
userStories.description: As a power user with hundreds of commitments, I need the app to load data in pages so it doesn't freeze.
acceptanceCriteria: LedgerViewModel loads commitments in pages of 50
Scroll-to-bottom triggers next page load with loading indicator
SyncService.pullCommitments() uses limit/offset pagination (max 100 per request)
ScreenshotProcessingService.processNewScreenshots() limits to 100 screenshots per batch
SmartBackfillService limits to 100 screenshots per backfill run
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All data loaded unbounded. Users with 1000+ commitments will experience freezes. SmartBackfillService loads all photos at once.

userStories.title: Optimize N+1 queries in sync and processing pipelines
userStories.description: As a developer, I need batch data fetching to eliminate N+1 query patterns that cause slowdowns.
acceptanceCriteria: SyncService.pullCommitments() fetches all local commitment IDs into a Set before the loop (not query per item)
ScreenshotProcessingService.processNewScreenshots() fetches all ProcessingQueue asset IDs into a Set before the loop
ClassifierFeedbackService.currentThreshold() result is cached once per processing batch (not called per screenshot)
No single-item fetch inside a loop that iterates over more than 10 items
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SyncService queries for each remote commitment individually. ScreenshotProcessingService queries ProcessingQueue per screenshot.

userStories.title: Add request deduplication for AI and summary services
userStories.description: As a developer, I need request deduplication to prevent wasted network calls and duplicate processing.
acceptanceCriteria: DisputeSummaryService tracks in-flight requests by entity ID and returns existing result if duplicate
ScreenshotProcessingService skips screenshots that already have commitments extracted
AIExtractionService tracks in-flight extraction requests and deduplicates
Deduplication state is cleared after 60 seconds to allow retries
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Same screenshot or entity can trigger duplicate AI calls. No deduplication mechanism exists.

userStories.title: Create custom 404 page for marketing website
userStories.description: As a visitor who hits a broken link, I want a helpful 404 page that guides me back to the site.
acceptanceCriteria: website/src/pages/404.astro exists using BaseLayout
Page shows 'Page not found' message with Seddly branding
Includes links to homepage, how-it-works, and support
Has proper title and meta tags (no indexing: noindex, nofollow)
Astro builds successfully
userStories.notes: No 404 page exists. Visitors hitting broken links see Astro's default error page.

userStories.title: Add cookie consent banner for GDPR/CCPA compliance
userStories.description: As a website visitor from EU/California, I need to consent to analytics before any tracking begins.
acceptanceCriteria: BaseLayout.astro includes a cookie consent banner at bottom of page
Banner explains what data is collected (analytics only, no personal data)
Accept and Decline buttons are provided
Consent choice is stored in localStorage
No analytics scripts load until consent is given
Banner does not show again after choice is made
Banner is accessible (keyboard navigable, screen reader compatible)
Astro builds successfully
userStories.notes: Privacy Policy mentions analytics but no consent mechanism exists. Required for GDPR/CCPA compliance.

userStories.title: Add JSON-LD Article schema to blog posts
userStories.description: As a content marketer, I need structured data on blog posts so they appear as rich results in Google search.
acceptanceCriteria: Each blog post .astro file includes JSON-LD Article schema
Schema includes @type: Article, headline, datePublished, author, description
Author is set to 'Seddly Team' with organization type
datePublished matches the published date shown on the page
Schema validates with Google's Rich Results Test
Astro builds successfully
userStories.notes: Blog posts have title/description meta tags but no JSON-LD structured data. Missing SEO opportunity.

userStories.title: Add web manifest and favicon size variants
userStories.description: As a mobile visitor, I need a web manifest and properly sized favicons for PWA-like behavior and bookmark icons.
acceptanceCriteria: website/public/manifest.json exists with name, short_name, icons, theme_color, background_color, display: standalone
BaseLayout.astro references manifest.json via <link rel='manifest'>
favicon-16x16.png and favicon-32x32.png exist in website/public/
BaseLayout references PNG favicon variants for browsers that don't support SVG
og-image.png exists (1200x630) for social sharing — convert existing SVG
apple-touch-icon.png exists (180x180) — convert existing SVG
Astro builds successfully
userStories.notes: Only SVG favicon exists. Many browsers/platforms need PNG variants. No manifest.json for PWA support.

userStories.title: Add keyboard focus styles and ARIA attributes to website
userStories.description: As a keyboard-only user, I need visible focus indicators and proper ARIA attributes to navigate the website.
acceptanceCriteria: BaseLayout.astro adds :focus-visible styles for all interactive elements (links, buttons)
Focus indicator is clearly visible (minimum 2px outline with offset)
Nav toggle button has aria-controls linking to nav-links id
nav-links div has id attribute matching aria-controls
Skip-to-content link is first focusable element
All interactive elements are reachable via Tab key
Astro builds successfully
userStories.notes: No :focus-visible styles defined. Nav toggle has aria-expanded but missing aria-controls. No skip-to-content link.

userStories.title: Add database indexes for frequently queried columns
userStories.description: As a developer, I need proper indexes on the Supabase database to prevent slow queries at scale.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration adds index on commitments(user_id, confidence) for filtered queries
New migration adds index on privacy_audit_log(user_id, timestamp DESC) for time-range queries
New migration adds index on processing_log(device_id, processed_at DESC) for device analytics
New migration adds index on custom_workflows(user_id, created_at DESC) for listing
Dollar amount column changed to DECIMAL(10,2) for precision
Migration runs successfully
userStories.notes: Missing indexes on confidence, timestamp, and processing_log. Dollar amount has no precision specified.

userStories.title: Add state restoration for app UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to remember my last viewed screen, filters, and scroll position when I return.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyApp saves selected tab (Ledger/Settings) to UserDefaults on scenePhase change to .background
SeddlyApp restores selected tab on launch
LedgerViewModel saves current filter and sort to UserDefaults
LedgerViewModel restores filter and sort on init
Deep link navigation state is preserved across app launches
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: App always opens to default state. No ScenePhase handling for saving UI state. Users lose context every time they switch apps.

userStories.title: Add haptic feedback to key interactions
userStories.description: As a user, I want haptic feedback on important actions so the app feels responsive and tactile.
acceptanceCriteria: Status change in CommitmentDetailView triggers UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(.medium)
Adding to calendar triggers UINotificationFeedbackGenerator(.success)
Applying filters triggers UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(.light)
Bulk selection toggle triggers UISelectionFeedbackGenerator
Entity merge triggers UINotificationFeedbackGenerator(.success)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Only LedgerView swipe actions have haptic feedback. All other interactions feel flat.

userStories.title: Fix Share Extension error handling and memory management
userStories.description: As a user sharing screenshots to Seddly, I need the share extension to handle errors gracefully and not lose data.
acceptanceCriteria: ShareViewController shows user-visible error if ModelContext save fails (not silent try?)
Image loading checks available memory before processing full-resolution images
Processing has a 10-second timeout with user notification if exceeded
Failed saves are queued for retry on next app launch
RuleFilterService score is called once per text (not twice)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Share Extension uses silent try? for saves, loads images without memory checks, and calls ruleFilterService.score() twice.

userStories.title: Add SyncService client-side batching and rate limiting
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SyncService to batch uploads and respect rate limits to prevent network storms.
acceptanceCriteria: SyncService.syncCommitments() uploads in batches of 50 with 500ms delay between batches
SyncService.pullCommitments() pages results with limit=100 and cursor-based pagination
Client-side rate limiting prevents more than 1 sync per 30 seconds
Sync progress is reportable (X of Y items synced)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SyncService pushes all items in a loop with no batching. Pull fetches all remote commitments at once.

userStories.title: Add unit tests for untested critical services
userStories.description: As a developer, I need test coverage for critical services that currently have zero tests.
acceptanceCriteria: AuthService tests: signInWithApple stores token, signOut clears Keychain, isAuthenticated reads correctly
SubscriptionService tests: tier detection, Pro+ feature gating, transaction listener
BackgroundTaskService tests: registration, scheduling, expiration handling
OCRService tests: text extraction from sample image, empty image handling
ScreenshotProcessingService tests: end-to-end pipeline with mock AI, duplicate detection
All tests use Swift Testing framework (@Test, #expect)
Tests pass
userStories.notes: 18 of 26 services have zero test coverage. Critical paths (auth, sync, subscription, processing) are completely untested.

userStories.title: Add integration tests for critical pipelines
userStories.description: As a developer, I need integration tests covering the full screenshot-to-commitment pipeline and sync flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test: Screenshot → OCR → Classifier → RuleFilter → AI → Commitment creation
Integration test: Commitment created locally → SyncService push → verify remote state
Integration test: Remote commitment → SyncService pull → verify local state
Integration test: Share Extension → ProcessingQueue → Background processing → Commitment
Tests use in-memory ModelContainer and mock network calls
Tests pass
userStories.notes: No integration tests exist. Only unit tests for individual services.

userStories.title: Add Siri Shortcuts for mark-as-fulfilled and entity lookup
userStories.description: As a power user, I want Siri Shortcuts to mark commitments as fulfilled and check specific entities without opening the app.
acceptanceCriteria: MarkFulfilledIntent: accepts commitment summary text, finds matching commitment, marks as fulfilled
CheckEntityIntent: accepts entity name, returns accountability score and overdue count
UpdateDeadlineIntent: accepts commitment and new date, updates deadline
All intents have Siri suggestion phrases
SeddlyShortcuts provider includes all new intents
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Only 2 Siri Shortcuts exist (add commitment, check overdue). Missing key workflows like marking fulfilled or checking entities.

userStories.title: Add offline mode indicator and Pro feature warnings
userStories.description: As a user, I want to know when I'm offline and when Pro features are unavailable so I'm not confused by silent failures.
acceptanceCriteria: LedgerView shows 'Offline' banner at top when network is unreachable
When offline and user tries AI extraction, show clear message that AI requires internet
When offline and user tries sync, show clear message that sync requires internet
Banner auto-dismisses when connectivity is restored
Uses NWPathMonitor for reliable connectivity detection
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: App has offline toggle in Settings but no automatic offline detection or user-facing indicators.

userStories.title: Add onboarding navigation improvements
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to navigate back through onboarding steps and see my progress clearly.
acceptanceCriteria: OnboardingView allows swiping back to previous pages
Back button visible on pages 2+
Progress indicator shows current step clearly (not just dots)
Skip button available on every page
Final page has clear CTA to start using the app
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: OnboardingView uses TabView with pagination but no back button. Users can't revisit earlier steps.

userStories.title: Add CI code quality checks and build caching
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CI to enforce code quality and cache builds so PRs are validated faster.
acceptanceCriteria: ci.yml adds SwiftLint step after build (fail on errors, warn on warnings)
ci.yml adds build caching (Xcode derived data or buildcache-action)
ci.yml adds test coverage reporting (minimum 60% coverage gate)
deploy-website.yml adds HTML output validation step before deploy
deploy-supabase.yml adds deno lint and deno check steps before deploy
XcodeGen version is pinned in ci.yml
All workflows pass
userStories.notes: CI builds and tests but has no quality gates, no caching, and no code coverage reporting. Each build starts from scratch.

userStories.title: Add Edge Function structured logging and audit trail
userStories.description: As a developer, I need structured logging in Edge Functions for debugging and security monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: All Edge Functions log with structured format: { timestamp, requestId, action, userId, statusCode }
extract-commitments logs extraction requests to privacy_audit_log table
generate-dispute-summary logs summary generation to privacy_audit_log table
Error logs include correlation ID for request tracing
No PII (email, names, text content) is included in log messages
Sensitive errors return generic messages to client while logging details server-side
userStories.notes: Edge Functions use console.log with no structure. No audit trail for AI operations. Debugging production issues is nearly impossible.

userStories.title: Add cascade delete rules and soft delete support
userStories.description: As a developer, I need proper delete cascades and soft delete for data integrity and compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: LocalCommitment relationship to entity uses .nullify delete rule (commitment survives entity deletion)
CustomWorkflow references use .nullify delete rule
Supabase migration adds deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ column to commitments and entities tables
SyncService respects soft delete (marks deleted_at instead of hard delete)
Privacy Policy 30-day retention is enforced via pg_cron job that hard-deletes after 30 days
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Privacy Policy promises 30-day retention after deletion, but migrations use hard CASCADE deletes. No soft delete mechanism exists.

userStories.title: Add UserDefaults consistency across app group
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all UserDefaults access to use the app group suite so data is shared correctly between app and extensions.
acceptanceCriteria: All UserDefaults reads/writes use UserDefaults(suiteName: appGroupIdentifier)
NotificationService uses app group suite (not standard UserDefaults)
SettingsView AppStorage uses app group suite for settings shared with extensions
Audit of all @AppStorage and UserDefaults.standard usages confirms no standard defaults for shared state
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Some services use app group UserDefaults, others use standard. Data stored in standard is invisible to Share Extension and Widget.

userStories.title: Add ScreenshotProcessingService caching and batching
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the processing pipeline to cache intermediate results and batch operations for efficiency.
acceptanceCriteria: Entity lookups are cached for the duration of a processing batch (not fetched per commitment)
ClassifierFeedbackService.currentThreshold() is called once before the loop (not per screenshot)
OCR results are cached in ProcessingQueue to avoid re-processing the same screenshot
Maximum 100 screenshots processed per batch with continuation token for next batch
AI extraction responses are validated (max 100 commitments per response)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Processing pipeline has redundant fetches inside loops. No caching. No batch size limits.

userStories.title: Add caching layer for PhotoKit and network responses
userStories.description: As a developer, I need caching to prevent redundant PhotoKit queries and network calls.
acceptanceCriteria: ScreenshotService caches fetchNewScreenshots() results for 30 seconds
AIExtractionService caches extraction results by text hash for 5 minutes
APIAccessService caches listCommitments() results for 15 seconds
Cache is invalidated on relevant user actions (new screenshot detected, manual refresh)
Cache uses NSCache with memory-aware eviction
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Every call to services re-queries from scratch. No in-memory caching exists anywhere.

userStories.title: Add undo support for commitment status changes
userStories.description: As a user, I want to undo accidental status changes within a few seconds so I can recover from mistakes.
acceptanceCriteria: After swipe-to-dismiss or swipe-to-fulfill, show a 5-second toast with Undo button
Undo reverts commitment to previous status
Toast auto-dismisses after 5 seconds, making the change permanent
Only one undo is active at a time (new action replaces previous undo)
Undo works for bulk status changes too
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No undo mechanism exists. Accidental swipes permanently change commitment status.

userStories.title: Add search to ReviewQueueView and EntityMergeView
userStories.description: As a user with many items, I want to search within the review queue and entity merge views to find specific items quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: ReviewQueueView has .searchable() modifier that filters by entity name and summary
EntityMergeView has .searchable() modifier that filters merge candidates by name
Search is case-insensitive
Empty search results show 'No matches' message
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: ReviewQueueView and EntityMergeView have no search. Hard to find items in large lists.

userStories.title: Add confirmation notification after setting custom reminders
userStories.description: As a user, I want confirmation that my custom reminder was scheduled so I trust it will fire.
acceptanceCriteria: CommitmentDetailView shows success toast/banner after scheduling a custom reminder
Toast shows the reminder time in human-readable format (e.g., 'Reminder set for tomorrow at 9am')
If notification permission is denied, shows alert explaining how to enable in Settings
Toast auto-dismisses after 3 seconds
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Custom reminder is scheduled with no user confirmation. User has no way to know if it was actually set.

userStories.title: Add website color contrast fixes and focus styles
userStories.description: As a website visitor, I need text to meet WCAG AA contrast ratios and all interactive elements to be keyboard-navigable.
acceptanceCriteria: --color-text-muted (#8b8b94) on --color-bg (#0a0a0b) meets 4.5:1 ratio or is lightened
All body text on dark background meets WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal, 3:1 for large)
CTA buttons have visible :focus-visible outline (2px, offset from element)
Skip-to-content link added as first focusable element in BaseLayout
Tab order follows logical reading order on all pages
Astro builds successfully
userStories.notes: --color-text-muted (#8b8b94) on #0a0a0b has ~5.5:1 ratio (OK), but needs verification. No focus styles or skip-to-content link exist.

userStories.title: Add SwiftData indexes on frequently queried local model fields
userStories.description: As a developer, I need local database indexes to prevent slow queries as users accumulate data.
acceptanceCriteria: ProcessingQueue model adds @Attribute(.unique) or index on screenshotAssetID
PrivacyAuditEntry model adds index hint on timestamp field
LocalCommitment model adds index hints on statusRaw and deadline fields
Performance tested with 1000+ commitments to verify improvement
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No index attributes on SwiftData models. ProcessingQueue.screenshotAssetID is queried in every processing loop without index.

userStories.title: Add BackgroundTaskService internal timeout
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the background task to respect time budgets so iOS doesn't penalize the app for overrunning.
acceptanceCriteria: BackgroundTaskService.processNewScreenshotsInBackground() has 25-second internal timeout
If timeout is reached, processing stops gracefully and saves partial progress
Remaining screenshots are picked up in the next background task run
Timeout is separate from (and shorter than) system expiration handler
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: No internal timeout. Relies entirely on system expiration handler which may arrive too late for clean shutdown.

userStories.title: Add Supabase Edge Function input validation hardening
userStories.description: As a developer, I need robust input validation on all Edge Functions to prevent malformed requests from causing errors.
acceptanceCriteria: extract-commitments wraps req.json() in try-catch, returns 400 on malformed JSON
extract-commitments validates text is string, non-empty, max 10000 chars
generate-dispute-summary validates commitments is array, max 100 items, each has required fields
api-commitments validates all update fields against whitelist (no unexpected keys)
All validation errors return descriptive 400 responses with field-level errors
Typecheck passes
